title: Orders forwards a broken token to payments
description: Orders drops the 'Bearer' scheme when it forwards the caller's token. Payments rejects every call, so no order can be paid.

title: Declined payments show as paid
description: Orders marks an order as paid when payments returns any 201 response, even a declined payment.

title: Payment limit is off by one
description: Payments uses 'less than' instead of 'less than or equal to'. A payment of exactly $1,000 is declined.

title: Any user can read any order by ID
description: GET /orders/:id does not check the owner. A signed-in user can read another user's order if they know its ID.

title: Any user can read any payment by ID
description: GET /payments/:id does not check the payer. A signed-in user can read another user's payment if they know its ID.

title: Orders accepts a negative quantity
description: The quantity check rejects only zero. A negative quantity creates an order with a negative total.

title: Order responses leak the user's access token
description: A leftover debug field copies the caller's bearer token into every stored order. The API returns it in order responses.

title: Item names are not escaped on the orders page
description: The web page writes the item name into the HTML without escaping. An item name with a script runs in the browser.
